main_text.p: dorum honores: sed vel maximè traductiones ad superiores ordines & imperia: idque laudatissimo quorun-dam Regum exemplo: qui obscuro quoque loco natos, ob res domi militiaeque fortiter & laudabiliter gestas, ad summas evexere dignitates.ad sublimio-res evehendi dignitates.

Sic nimirum HERMANNUM BILINGUM, pauperibus ortum natalibus, virum acris ingenii, OTHO I. Imperator primùm filiis suis adolescentiae & morum informatorem adjunxit: dehinc Italicam contra Berengarium suscepturus expeditionem, Albianae Saxo-niae,95* quae jam indè à Witichindo nullum peculiarem Principem habuerat, administrationem ipsi commisit: fidem tandem ejus & integritatem expertus, in alterâ in Italiam expeditione Ducem eum Saxoniae creavit.966. Cranzius lib.4.Sax.c.8.9.15.

Sic & OTHONI Majori, Comiti Wittelsbachio, aquilifero suo (qui saepiùs susceptâ legatione in Italiam & Græciam profectus, Caesari modestè paredo[?], omnem suam operam Reipublicae devoverat, omnes nervos disciplinae militari intenderat, plurima in Italiâ praeclara facinora fortiter ediderat) FRIDERICUS I. Imperator, Ratisbonae in Comitiis, Henrico Leone crimine laesae majestatis damnato, Bavaria ducatum virtutis ergò concessit.1180.

Pari modo FRIDERICUS Comes Zollerius ab Imperatore RUDOLPHO Habsburgio, cui cùm aliàs saepe, tum inprimis in bello Basileensi suam probaverat fidem, veterum Burggraviorum Noribergensium, è prosapiâ Marchionum Vogburgiorum, familiâ exstinctâ, dignitate istâ est remuneratus. Hujus posteà pronepos FRIDERICUS IV Burggravius Noribergensis, ob fidem & strenuam SIGISMUNDO Imperatori in Hungaricis, Bohemicis, & Imperii difficilimis negotiis operam praestitam, remunerationis ergò Marchiam Brandeburgensem, una cum Electoratus dignitate accepit: in suamque stirpem perpetuâ successione propagavit.1273.1417.
Eidem Imperatori contra rebelles Bohemos mili-

page.notes: The first marginal note's words are printed across three lines, with the hyphen after "sublimio-" kept as printed. The mark "95*" is as printed. A small mark near "in alterâ" is doubtful and was not transcribed. "Cranzius lib.4.Sax.c.8.9.15." sits on its own full line after "creavit." and is kept in the paragraph. "paredo" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "parendo"; it is marked [?]. The page ends mid-word ("mili-"), so the paragraph continues on the next page.
